en:
What can we each do to make sure that
we all survive...?

We all possess <CLT=cltSTRONG>Ultimate<CLT=cltNORMAL> talents.
There *must* be something we can do.
<CLT=cltMIND>Should I hang out with Keebo for a while?

Of course! Let's think about what each one
of us can do!

<CLT=cltMIND>Keebo and I spent some time discussing
what each one of us could do.

<CLT=cltMIND>It was difficult to avoid being robophobic,
but time passed quickly enough...
<CLT=cltMIND>Keebo and I grew a little closer today.
